capabilities: Cycle text colors on selected text via hotkey
Cycle highlight (background) colors on selected text
Customize color sequences in settings with CSS names or hex codes
Assign hotkeys for each cycling command
Clear styling at the end of a cycle using a null step
disambiguation: Not a theming or appearance tool; it applies inline HTML color styling to selected text only.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply or cycle inline text and highlight colors from the keyboard.
summary: Hotkey-driven plugin that cycles text and highlight colors on selected text through customizable CSS color sequences.
